response.sql: WITH award_stats AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') as hand, COUNT(*) as tally, COUNT(*) OVER () as total_awards FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')), with_shares AS (SELECT hand, tally, total_awards, CAST(tally AS FLOAT) / total_awards as share, AVG(CAST(tally AS FLOAT) / total_awards) OVER () as avg_share FROM award_stats) SELECT hand, tally, share, share - avg_share as excess FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Every row in player_award represents a finalized award to a player (not a nomination, vote, or preliminary record); the schema provides no documentation to distinguish award types
